title: Dad Pete Joel — EN/DE/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar German Mandarin language learning warm baritone 106bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual family lineage rugby Australian
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Three McIvor men. Same game. Different eras.
Dad. Pete. Joel first grade.
Corey found the ocean.
Federation of commanders. Each in their own sphere.

[Verse 2 - German, with English translations]
Drei McIvor-Männer. Dasselbe Spiel. Verschiedene Epochen. (Three McIvor men. Same game. Different eras.)
Dad. Pete. Joel Erste Liga. (Dad. Pete. Joel first grade.)
Corey fand den Ozean. (Corey found the ocean.)
Verband der Kommandeure. Jeder in seiner eigenen Sphäre. (Federation of commanders. Each in their own sphere.)
Die Familie braucht jeden in seiner richtigen Form. (The family needs everyone in their right form.)

[Chorus - Mandarin, with English translations]
爸爸，皮特，乔尔 (Dad, Pete, Joel)
三个麦克艾弗男人在球场上 (Three McIvor men on the field)
爸爸，皮特，乔尔 (Dad, Pete, Joel)
家族血液中的橄榄球 (Rugby in the family blood)
爸爸，皮特，乔尔 (Dad, Pete, Joel)
他们携带的形式 (The form they carry)
即使没有人在看 (Even when no one is watching)
爸爸，皮特，乔尔 (Dad, Pete, Joel)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Corey went to the ocean. The family is richer for both paths.
German: Corey ging zum Ozean. Die Familie ist reicher für beide Wege. (Corey went to the ocean. Richer for both paths.)
Mandarin: 科里去了海洋。两条路让家庭更丰富。(Corey went to the ocean. Both paths make the family richer.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact
German: Vater Pete Joel — das Erbe ist intakt (Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact)
Mandarin: 爸爸皮特乔尔 — 血脉完整 (Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact)
